basic_info.description: In the heart of Pacific Heights, this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo blends timeless Beaux-Arts architecture with modern comfort. Nestled between Jackson and Washington Streets, you're steps from iconic SF landmarks, boutique shopping, and vibrant dining. The spacious 1,098 sq ft layout features well-proportioned rooms, hardwood floors throughout, a formal dining room, and a bright, inviting living space. An exclusive outdoor porch offers the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Secure garage parking adds rare convenience in this prime location. Residents enjoy a beautifully maintained shared yard and on-site laundry in the building's lobby. Set in a boutique 6-unit building with classic curb appeal, this is a rare opportunity to own a slice of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhood. Experience the perfect blend of architectural charm, modern ease, and an unbeatable location.
